type: Independent source closure review and inspection of existing development test log. Reviewer did not run tests, build, execute helper/native/GUI actions, or edit source.
implementationState: Uncommitted execution-receipts WIP; journal primitive is not connected to any runtime path.
scope: Strict journal storage primitive for process-crash recovery only; no power-loss or whole-system-crash guarantee is accepted here.

findings.original: A marker rename followed by failing directory fsync exposed a new terminal despite append failure.
findings.correction: Before replacement, pending.json durably records the previous watermark. Reader selects that watermark whenever a guard exists. Marker data and rename directory are fsynced before the final successful pending unlink publishes the new watermark.
findings.sourceAssessment: The original failure window retains a valid previous guard and exposes an incomplete old prefix. A process killed before unlink stays conservative; a process killed after unlink exposes the published prefix. No subsequent fallible durability syscall follows publication.
findings.developmentCounterexampleObserved: test_directory_fsync_failure_after_marker_rename_keeps_previous_prefix injects failure at the second directory fsync, asserts commit sequence advanced while pending guard remains, and requires only the old nonterminal prefix.

findings.original: FIFO nodes could block open before _regular validated their descriptor types.
findings.correction: Potentially existing allocation.lock, events.ndjson, commit.json and pending.json are opened with O_NONBLOCK and O_NOFOLLOW, then validated as owned single-link regular files.
findings.developmentCounterexampleObserved: test_fifo_names_are_refused_before_any_blocking_open covers the allocation lock and events/commit leaves; _read_marker shares the same NONBLOCK validation for pending.

findings.original: A stale events size paired with a newer marker could falsely appear corrupt.
findings.correction: append holds exclusive flock on the events descriptor throughout write/publication. read_receipts holds a shared flock, selects a marker snapshot first, then obtains events size and reads the committed prefix under that lock.
findings.developmentCounterexampleObserved: test_reader_waits_for_a_coherent_concurrent_commit pauses the writer during data fsync, requires the reader to wait, then requires a consistent complete two-record trace.

additionalChecks: Closed writer is rejected structurally before acquiring a lock on a cleared descriptor.
Existing failure, capacity, exact argument blob, sequence, symlink and context-scope checks remain present.
Publication unlink is deliberately a process-crash namespace barrier. Reappearing pending after power loss can make recovery conservative; this review does not promote that to a power-loss guarantee.
outcome: All three v1 findings closed in the reviewed primitive. No new actionable source findings identified within this narrow scope.
stillRequired: Strict reader field semantics, stage transitions and argument-reference integrity validation.
Acknowledged-terminal retention and global disk-space management.
ACC metadata, wrappers and native adapter integration.
Node durable preparation and restart reconciliation.
Independent qualification for the journal primitive and later source-bound end-to-end gate evidence.
automaticLockRestoration: Only after whole P5 acceptance; no settings changed by reviewer.
